intro: Bold in form and quietly thoughtful in function, Upmods Marcel brings together tall comfort, subtle storage, and soft light. It is designed to elevate both your room and your routine.

features.title: Comfort that stands tall
features.text: The tall, rectangular cushioned headboard offers full back support with a tailored look — blending plush comfort and architectural edge in perfect balance.

features.title: Storage that lifts without effort
features.text: A smooth hydraulic lift reveals deep box storage beneath the bed — easy to access, effortless to use, and perfect for keeping your space clear and your life uncluttered. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: A surface that whispers calm
features.text: The matte engineered wood finish feels soft to the touch and easy on the eyes, offering a refined, neutral tone that blends quietly into any interior.

features.title: Cleverness tucked into the head
features.text: Discreet headboard storage gives you a hidden spot for bedtime essentials — made for the things you want near, but not always visible.

features.title: Light right where you need it
features.text: Integrated side tables with built-in LED lighting add warm glow and practical elegance, making winding down or reaching for a book feel effortless.

features.title: A ledge that reflects your life
features.text: The display ledge provides space for photos, candles, or personal objects — helping your bed feel more like your own, one small detail at a time.

name: Upmods Marcel Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Hydraulic Storage
